versions.changelog:
Initial release of Product Page Designer — generate international-brand-quality e-commerce pages for consumer electronics.

- Creates complete product pages: Hero, Features, Lifestyle, Specs, FAQ, and more, matching Apple/Nothing standards
- Gathers key product info (name, category, specs, price range, brand voice) for tailored outputs
- Produces AI image prompts and manages image generation/cleanup to prevent branding issues
- Offers detailed section-by-section structure, including Markdown tables and layout guidance for developers
- Includes robust quality checklist and category-specific templates for common electronics products
